title: Tender For Request for Quotation for Implementation of an Integrated Enterprise GIS and 3D Digital Twin Platform for Geo-Analytics Property Tax Enhancement Asset
scope_summary: Request for Quotation (RFQ) for an integrated Enterprise GIS and 3D Digital Twin Platform for geo-analytics, property tax enhancement, and asset management. The platform aims to leverage advanced geospatial technologies for urban planning and administration.

title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
scope_summary: Implementation of an integrated GIS-based asset management platform for Cochin International Airport, including comprehensive data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support (6 years AMC).

title: IoT Based Energy Monitoring and Asset Management
tendering_authority: Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation Of India (ALIMCO), Ministry Of Social Justice And Empowerment
scope_summary: Tender for IoT-based energy monitoring and asset management, including supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of various energy monitoring devices, digital circuit breaker controllers, ground monitoring devices, and integration of a water automation pump system with an IIoT 4.0 platform.
